import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p = params
    L = np.log(1+eps)
    S = np.sqrt(T)
    z = p[0] + p[1]*S + p[2]*T + p[3]/T + (p[4] + p[5]*T + p[6]*S)*L + (p[7] + p[8]*T)*L**2 + p[9]*L/(1+eps)
    return np.exp(z)
